summary: Bound workspace discovery and verify sequential refactoring scope

delivery.outcome: Koru workspace globs select only intended checkout depth, avoid generated/vendor trees and symlink escapes, and retain bounded sequential retry semantics. Verify with real autogrammar refactoring pilots and digest-bound wellmanifest/performance evidence.
nonGoals: No arbitrary edits in dirty or unselected repositories

architecture.decision: Match include globs one path segment at a time, bound traversal, and treat Git checkout roots as scan boundaries. Keep command execution serial and retry only failures.
architecture.rollback: Remove the standard-update allowlist entry and specialized handoff while retaining GOV-TICKET-001 supervision.

validation.evidence: Focused supervisor behavior plus managed repository gates
